**JPMorgan Chase had the higher net margin in fiscal 2023**, by about 4.4 percentage points. I took net margin as net income divided by total net revenue, using figures as I recall them from the 10-Ks rather than looking them up.

- **JPMorgan Chase:** net income of $49,552M on net revenue of $158,104M gives a margin of about 31.3%.
- **Bank of America:** net income of $26,515M on revenue, net of interest expense, of $98,581M gives a margin of about 26.9%.

The gap is 31.34% − 26.90% ≈ 4.45 percentage points.
